commitment: We will continue to add verified studies, benchmark-level harness changes and revised syntheses as new evidence becomes available. Each evidence release will be dated and traceable; the paper’s frozen snapshot will remain identifiable.
cadence: Updates are maintained by the project team after source verification. Literature membership, evidence revisions and website changes have separate dates. There is no automated claim of a complete or continuously refreshed search.

steps.title: Find & screen
steps.text: Track new papers and revisions; distinguish target-harness changes from optimizer design, model training and background work.

steps.title: Trace the change
steps.text: Record the setting, seed, actual edit, result and source location. Keep missing artifacts, regressions and transfer conditions visible.

steps.title: Revise & release
steps.text: Update the benchmark records and comparisons, document corrections, and publish a dated data version alongside the collection history.

releases.title: Compare mechanisms, not just domain labels
changes: Added a two-domain comparison studio for interface repairs, decision evidence and recovery, with concrete processing diagrams and linked evidence.
Added separate paper, collection and website dates, plus explicit curation and correction policies.
Reworked the repository overview around the survey’s questions, deliverables and maintenance commitments. This presentation update adds no studies or experimental findings.

releases.title: Meet the survey authors
changes: Added the five confirmed manuscript authors, in order, and their shared Penn State Statistics affiliation to the website and repository homepage.
Separated survey authorship from project development and AI assistance. The preprint link remains forthcoming.
Project information update only; no new literature search or evidence revision is claimed.

releases.title: Explore the editable layer
changes: Added an interactive spatial cover with four selectable harness surfaces and direct links to their evidence.
Opened four domain gateways and refined the result spotlights; animation supports pause and reduced-motion preferences.
Presentation update only: evidence counts, original findings and the paper snapshot are unchanged.

releases.title: A closer look at the evolving harness
changes: Redesigned the homepage with an interactive harness diagram, three source-linked result spotlights, and an explorable improvement workflow.
Added benchmark shortcuts and a reading guide for attribution, evidence strength and reuse conditions.
This is a presentation update: the 95 domain records, 235 collected papers and original evidence cutoff are unchanged.

releases.title: Benchmark evidence, opened up
changes: Added all 95 domain records with setting/seed, reported changes and evidence limits.
Added 27 comparison lenses and benchmark/setting filters across four domains.
Separated transfer settings, single-source observations and reporting gaps; clarified that ModularRSI’s detailed Go result is external to Terminal-Bench.

policy.title: Trace every substantive change
policy.text: New evidence identifies a task setting, starting harness, reusable edit, observed result and primary-source location. Reporting gaps remain explicit.

policy.title: Keep versions and units distinct
policy.text: A revised paper updates its source record. One artifact evaluated on several settings is not counted as several independent discoveries.

policy.title: Publish corrections with context
policy.text: A correction records what changed and why. Conflicting code, unclear retention and negative results remain attached to the original setting.

policy.title: Preserve the paper snapshot
policy.text: The frozen survey cutoff stays identifiable. A bibliography import or website redesign does not silently extend the evidence collection.
